{{Top|canon=Aostai system}}
The '''Aostai region''' was a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] traveled to the depths of the Aostai region. While there, Gallia remotely attended from her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] a meeting of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that had been convened to discuss the threat posed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] developed by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>
